build_default_partition: build a forward and backward graph partition from a joint FX GraphModule using default_partition
build_min_cut_partition: build a memory-optimal forward and backward graph partition using min_cut_rematerialization_partition
create_subgraph_extraction: create a subgraph from a joint FX graph by specifying input and output nodes
draw_fx_graph: draw an FX GraphModule as an SVG or PNG file using draw_graph
draw_and_partition_joint_graph: draw a joint graph and partition it into forward and backward modules using draw_joint_graph
